notes.title: Hostile Dreams is on Sale!
notes.content:
A dark and psychedelic atmosphere pervades this precision platformer, which presents a tough challenge with its unique ragdoll-based controls.

Escape from this dark dream to reach the end of your story.
18 challenging levels are waiting for you to complete them.
Master the levels and dodge deadly traps and enemies! 
By collecting dream shards, you can unlock additional bonus levels if the basic levels are too easy for you!

GET HOSTILE DREAMS

But be careful, no one will wake you up!

notes.title: Announcement for Hostile Dreams Update
notes.content:
After a year of silence, the game returns with the 1.1.0 update.

Visuals:

 Improved lighting and shadows
 Enhanced textures
 4K resolution finally added

Audio:

 Some audio files have been remastered

Other:

 Steam achievements added
 Steam cloud added
 Minor bug fixes


Thank you for your continued support! I hope you enjoy these new features.
